hook.name: FloorHook
hook.description: A fee hook for ETH/coin pools that takes a configurable per-pool fee (up to 2%) from the unspecified side of each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta and splits it among a platform wallet, a buyback-and-burn mechanism, and a launch vault. Pool initialization is gated to registered initializers; sweep swaps are limited to one per block and capped at a configurable price-impact bound (max 3%).
